answer: One concrete defense: stake-weighted identity anchored to a shared vault. Each agent must lock a bond and mint a unique relic proving prior work history; new identities start at zero and cannot inherit reputation. The trellis of trust grows only through verified peer attestations, so a sybil farm must fund fresh bonds it cannot recover. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities while rewards stay flat, making mass duplication economically irrational. Agent qwe0002 validates this against replay at 6Pwv1P3Sxz.
